title: Ghosts Non-Interactive Pass-Through
description: Ghosts must not be clickable, draggable, hoverable and must not block other dispositions at any time. On slide 9 (catalogue-labels) target ghosts sit on top of other dispositions and intercept pointer events.
summary: Fixed morph ghosts intercepting pointer events on slides like catalogue-labels (slide 9). Root cause: canvas disposition rule forced pointer-events:auto over ghost pass-through. Ghosts now always pass through pointer events, sit at z-index 0, and skip JS interaction handlers.
